checks.invariant: Gitignore must exclude operator secrets and local DBs; committed leftover catalog markdown must not hold client PII or keys.
checks.result: .gitignore excludes .env variants, *.db, /Images/, backend/data/, and data/, so inventory.db and Images/.env are not trackable. listings/ and Inventory_Report.md are not ignored. Inventory_Report.md is a two-lot markdown table (SKU 002/003, garment brands/sizes/prices) with no client identity or secrets. Missing ignore of catalog outputs is a leftover-operator hygiene gap without a lower-trust principal obtaining protected PII from current tracked files.

checks.invariant: The repo-root scanner must not be the production API entrypoint and must not ship listing JSON inside the API image.
checks.result: DEPLOY.md and README_SAAS.md document root main.py as a legacy CLI, not FastAPI. Procfile runs uvicorn app.main:app from backend/. Dockerfile.api copies requirements.txt, alembic.ini, and backend/ only, so listings/ and Inventory_Report.md are not in that image. A mis-set Nixpacks uvicorn main:app is documented as a crash (no app attribute), not a networked scanner. No backend tests import root main.py.

Retire or isolate root main.py from the SaaS repo if operators no longer need the tkinter scanner; there are no tests for it.
